Rank 22 - Agriculture

Poultry Batch Cost and Medicine Manager

Poultry farmers need batch cost, feed, medicine, mortality, sale weight, and profit in one place.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 6,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month is realistic when sold through local feed/vet shop channels.

7.0Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 6,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target broiler, layer, and Sonali farms through feed dealers and local veterinary medicine shops.

Farmers sell birds but may not know true batch profit after feed and medicine.

Know if the batch made money before starting the next one.

Validation signals

  • Commercial poultry farms are widespread.
  • Feed/medicine cost is daily pain.
  • Batch profit is easy to explain.
  • Dealers can distribute the app.

MVP modules

  • Batch setup
  • Chick count
  • Feed log
  • Medicine/vaccine log
  • Mortality count
  • Sale weight
  • Batch profit

Do not build first

  • Do not provide veterinary diagnosis.
  • Do not sell medicine advice as a doctor.
  • Do not add IoT first.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pilot with 20 farms.
  • Track one batch.
  • Show profit report.
  • Add reminder templates later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Farmer typing burden.
  • Disease events.
  • Agent support cost.
Mitigations
  • Daily quick entry.
  • No medical claims.
  • Dealer-assisted onboarding.
